mathematics_status.theorem: The shared-effect regret lower bound and common-kernel equivalence are correct for a finite nonempty collection, all positive weights summing to1, nonempty valid-token sets, epsilon>0, normalized states and real finite utilities. H may be indefinite.
proof_checks: A_it=rho_it+epsilon I is positive definite and S_i positive definite. K_i=S_i^(-1/2)H_i S_i^(-1/2) is Hermitian. Hence G_i=S_i^(1/2)(lambda_i I-K_i)S_i^(1/2) is PSD.

For normalized common phi, gap_i=phi^dagger G_i phi/(phi^dagger S_i phi). Since numerator>=0 and denominator<=L_i, gap_i>=phi^dagger(G_i/L_i)phi. Summing and applying the minimum-eigenvalue variational bound proves regret>=F>=0.

Zero gap is equivalent to G_i phi=0. Positive weights and PSD matrices imply ker(sum_i a_i G_i/L_i)=intersection_i ker(G_i). Finite-dimensional positivity then gives F>0 exactly when the common unconstrained kernel is trivial.

For the actual constrained circuit, a nonzero common kernel alone is insufficient: it must intersect an actually reachable ray. F0 does not certify an actual reachable optimum. Supremum on a closure and attainment by finite parameters are distinct.
Whitened F_it sum to identity, giving a sentence-specific token POVM representation. The transformed w_i depends on the sentence. It is not one shared relation-outcome POVM.

Correctness alone is not the substantive-contribution criterion. The current candidate explicitly acknowledges this uncertainty, which is appropriate; it should not be promoted to L5.
novelty_status.nearest_work_gap: The supplied quantum-feature/quantum-attention and normalization originals help locate the model but do not settle prior art in generalized Rayleigh optimization, positive sums, common maximizers, sums of ratios and shared-query attention expressivity. No new literature retrieval or first-of-kind certification was performed by this reviewer.
novelty_status.fairness: Classical exact equivalence, use of a known primitive or absence of hardware speedup does not independently veto a useful new methodological/theoretical contribution. Here the issue is the absence of a demonstrated substantive new result and empirical link, not classical simulability.

l5_status.same_contribution_gap: Local within-sentence usefulness of weight-to-value alignment does not establish that one relation-shared effect is a binding cross-sentence bottleneck. An elegant bound about another limitation cannot simply be attached to the L4 card.

l5_status.retention: Keep exact code, this compact mathematical review, preliminary lemma and negative counterexamples. There is no new checkpoint, private restore or model-output retention requirement.

source_correspondence.actual_code: Inspected RMEAHead.forward and circuit without importing or executing torch. quantum probability is abs(phi.conj() dot psi)^2; EPS=1e-6; raw=(probability+EPS)*valid mask; alpha is row-normalized; utilities=value(h) dot decoder_r; logits=sum alpha*utilities+bias. All40 relation effects are separate binary measurements. The three-qubit two-layer RY/RZ+CNOT circuit and tanh angle constraints restrict reachable states.
source_correspondence.masking: The positive-definite sums concern only valid tokens; code rejects all-false masks. Padding does not contribute A, S or H. The theory pools all valid tokens, whereas the accepted L4 permutation changes eligible nonentity context weights while preserving entities; that intervention distinction is material.
source_correspondence.mode_scope: The pure-state overlap derivation is for quantum mode. Dephased mode has a different diagonal probability formula; results must not silently be transferred as if the same phase-sensitive effect were used.
source_correspondence.numeric_limit: Unitary circuits give normalized states in exact arithmetic. Actual float32/complex64 or float64/complex128 introduces finite precision; any real-data numerical sign of F requires residual/eigenvalue error control. No actual forward or numerical-source execution was performed.
source_correspondence.source_identity_note: executed_rmea.py is an embedded packet source identity, not a separate file in this review directory. Its UTF8 hash independently matches the actual preserved historical producer file.

risks.detail: Sentence-specific relaxed optima are not necessarily circuit-attainable; epsilon-supported unused directions can make this certificate nearly vacuous.
Learned preparation, value and decoder changes can remove a fixed-feature obstruction; no whole-model impossibility or expected CE/Macro gain follows.
This review finds no established substantive novelty. It does not prove that the exact proposition is previously published or exhaust all mathematical/attention literature.
Common optimizer compatibility is not quantum measurement joint measurability. Binary effect rows do not form a relation POVM, and the shared-query phenomenon has classical counterparts.
